outcome: Trends in hysterectomy rates for placenta percreta
cohort: 1055 women diagnosed with placenta percreta who underwent cesarean delivery between October 2015 and December 2018, identified through the National Inpatient Sample database
finding: While hysterectomy at cesarean delivery for placenta percreta increased from 2015 to 2018, conservative management was associated with lower surgical morbidity.
gest_age: Median gestational age for conservative management: 36 weeks, Median gestational age for hysterectomy: 34 weeks
